newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- EOE puts rise, but volatility draws few.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- EOE puts rise, but volatility draws few.

text.p: EOE put options increased on Tuesday as the U.S. dragged down the share market, but reasonable stock volatility failed to interest investors, dealers said.

Some traders placed a few strategic puts in the AEX index for December at 605, 600 and 590 points, but the most heavily traded AEX option was a call, at 615. The expiry of December options on Friday also led a number of traders to roll over their contracts.
Of individual stocks, put options in Unilever clearly caught the eye after the 7.00 guilder rise of the shares on Monday
Unilever shares fell by as much as 3.30 guilders, although, towards the close on Tuesday, they were only down 80 cents.
Overall, calls and puts almost evened out, but the total volume was low.
"It looks like it's going to be a quiet expiry," one trader said.
